auxiliary.evidence_text: Cornell Pump Company proudly maintains its ISO9001:2008 certification which validates that Cornell is in compliance with all necessary processes to meet customer requirements. The elements associated with ISO 9001:2008 certification include such areas as contract review, design and development, production, purchasing, quality control and service.
